tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background (app shell, portal).

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Raised panels: cards, tables, popovers. Sits on surface-100.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Sunken or subtle fills: table headers, inputs, chart plot area.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers. Not for borders that carry meaning (use border-strong).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, checkboxes). At least 3:1 on surface-100 and surface-200 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface-100, surface-200 and surface-300.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, axis labels on surface-100, surface-200 and surface-300.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Technology blue. Primary buttons, active nav, selected state, main chart series, focus ring. Text on it uses on-primary.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of primary fills.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary and primary-hover fills.

tokens.name: primary-subtle
tokens.usage: Tinted blue backgrounds: selected rows, info banners, chart bands. Text on it uses on-primary-subtle.

tokens.name: on-primary-subtle
tokens.usage: Text on primary-subtle.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links on surface-100 and surface-200.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Deep navy for hero fills, covers and secondary chart series. Decorative: do not put small text on it without on-primary.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Subtle red. Reserved for meaning: score regression, open alert, failed audit, Suspended client. Never decoration. Text and icons on surface-100, surface-200.

tokens.name: danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of alert banners and danger badges. Text on it uses on-danger-subtle.

tokens.name: on-danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Text on danger-subtle.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Healthy score and recovered alert. A blue-teal, not green, so status never relies on red versus green. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Scores that need improvement (Lighthouse 50-89) on surface-100 and surface-200. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Solid 2px keyboard focus ring with 2px offset. At least 3:1 on surface-100 and surface-200 in both themes.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Portal and cover hero. One per screen.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: Large score numerals in gauges and KPI tiles.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running text. Rajdhani at 500 reads cleaner than 400.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Table cells and dense data. Never below 14px.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows and column headers. Set the text in capitals.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside controls and tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding, input padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop, section separation.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Large separation between page regions.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, inputs. The system is angular, matching Rajdhani's squared forms.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Modals and the PWA install sheet. The largest radius in the system.
